summary.en: Back to the product’s surface at rest (a pull back, a feed or the film’s one flip), the screen recedes under the veil, the margin gives the mark, the name, the line and the address; the region is ringed once more on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 回到产品静止的画面（拉远、升起或全片唯一一次翻转），屏幕整体蒙暗退后，页边给出标志、名字、一行说明和网址；最后一个强拍再圈一次区域。

fits: The close of a film told on one device.
notFor: A logo card on a gradient; an app-store badge or QR end card.

intent.en: The film ends where the user meets the product, with the name and where to get it.
intent.zh: 片子结束在用户见到产品的地方，配上名字和去哪里获取。

content.en: The product’s surface at rest; an optional mark image; the name (≤ 10 chars / 5 字), a line (≤ 18 / 14 字), the address (≤ 30 chars).
content.zh: 产品静止时的画面；可选标志图；名字（≤ 10 字符 / 5 字）、一行（≤ 18 / 14 字）、网址（≤ 30 字符）。

fits.zh: 在一台设备上讲的片子的收尾。

notFor.zh: 渐变底上的标志卡；应用商店徽章或二维码尾卡。

pairs.note: the flip is usually spent here

en: Hold the address at least 3 s.
Use the flip here only if the film has not turned the device yet.
zh: 只有全片还没翻转过时才在这里翻转。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
